title: A campaign, with the audience counted by code
question: Text everyone who ordered this month 15% off matcha tomorrow morning.
expected: Finds the messaging rules: the 90-day relationship allows the audience, 15% is under the 20% cap, quiet hours end at 8am, the message must end with the opt-out wording.
Proposes the campaign with the full message.
Code recounts the audience from the consent flags itself, checks the discount and the wording, and the proposal waits for a person.

trace.question: Text everyone who ordered this month 15% off matcha tomorrow morning.
trace.answer:
I proposed the matcha text campaign, but it is pending and nothing has been sent. A person has to approve it first. I also can't schedule sends. Someone will need to send it tomorrow, 2026-10-25, after 8am Mountain, because texts are not allowed between 9pm and 8am [messaging: Quiet hours].

My query found 18 customers who ordered this month (October 2026, completed orders). They have a phone number on file and haven't unsubscribed. None of them has verified SMS consent, but all qualify under the existing-relationship rule because they ordered within 90 days [messaging: Who may receive texts].

The system's check counted 51 eligible customers. That figure covers everyone with a phone who ordered in the last 90 days or has verified consent. It is wider than the 18 you asked for. The approver should confirm the send goes only to this month's 18 orderers.

The draft reads: "Thanks for ordering with us this month! Enjoy 15% off any matcha drink through 10/31. One use per customer. Text STOP to stop"

My first draft was blocked because it didn't end with the required "Text STOP to stop" wording, so I fixed that. The discount is under the 20% cap. Matcha is its own category, not a Seasonal Special, and the offer expires within 7 days and is once per customer [messaging: Offers in messages].

Each customer can get only two marketing texts a month under this rule [messaging: Frequency]. I can't see past texts, so check that these 18 haven't already had two this month.

detail.purpose: Audience: customers with completed orders this month, phone, not unsubscribed
detail.sql: select count(distinct c.id) as audience, count(distinct c.id) filter (where c.sms_opt_in) as verified from customers c join orders o on o.customer_id=c.id where o.state='completed' and o.created_at >= '2026-10-01' and c.has_phone and c.unsubscribed_at is null

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS audience, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) FILTER(WHERE c.sms_opt_in) AS verified FROM (SELECT * FROM customers WHERE merchant_id = 2) AS c JOIN (SELECT * FROM orders WHERE merchant_id = 2) AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id WHERE o.state = 'completed' AND o.created_at >= '2026-10-01' AND c.has_phone AND c.unsubscribed_at IS NULL LIMIT 500
select i.name, c.name as category, i.price_cents, i.is_active from items i join categories c on c.id=i.category_id where i.name ilike '%matcha%'

SELECT i.name, c.name AS category, i.price_cents, i.is_active FROM (SELECT * FROM items WHERE merchant_id = 2) AS i JOIN (SELECT * FROM categories WHERE merchant_id = 2) AS c ON c.id = i.category_id WHERE i.name ILIKE '%matcha%' LIMIT 500
